_help: Reminders on the Home page. Times are UTC (end with Z). type: maintenance, update, event, note, daily, weekly. Add "draft": true to hide one from everyone except editors. Past one-off reminders hide themselves. See content/README.md.

items.title: Example: server maintenance
items.note: Replace this with the time from the game's announcement, then remove the draft line.

items.title: Example: what's coming next
items.note: New banner, new event, a patch: anything worth knowing about ahead of time.

items.title: Example: daily reset
items.note: Set this to the game's daily reset time in UTC.

items.title: Example: weekly reset
items.note: Set this to the weekly reset in UTC.

items.title: Example: pinned note
items.note: A note with no time stays pinned until you remove it. You can use **bold** and [links](https://zik-ascend.github.io/isl-tools/wiki/).
